purpose: Close the remaining local external-evidence interface gaps found after V2 sealing: materialize the nested parser receipt, freeze exact external integrity/provenance, make the authorized-client boundary capability-specific, totalize stop normalization, disclose manual-attestation limits, and bind the default transport through urllib3.

supersession.preservation_law: PROGRAM_CONTRACT_V1.json and PROGRAM_CONTRACT_V2.json remain immutable evidence and are never edited or overwritten.
supersession.effective_contract_rule: Every V1/V2 term remains binding except where V3 expressly replaces the effective execution identity, nested parser receipt file law, top-level external integrity/authorization-effect law, authorized-client provenance, stop-normalization closure, owner-attestation epistemic claim, transport-source closure, or local-receipt/test bindings. V3 governs an express conflict.
unchanged_terms: local-build-only authority and every external/outcome/spend prohibition
sealed Job-49 declaration and exact 2440-call scope
V2 canonical one-use authorization, freshness, consumption-marker, and no-resume laws
V2 raw and normalized result bindings and durable reread law
V2 top-level Job-50 wrapper and nested Job-49 structural-parser classification
V2 declaration-scoped claims and bounded local tamper-evidence boundary
V2 precredential local-readiness and SDK-identity gate

authority_effect.reason: All V3 work is local contract, code, fake-client test, synthetic artifact, and receipt repair before any credential, client, vendor, network, outcome, acquisition, or order action.

effective_program_contract_identity.value_law: Every new synthetic/external journal, response, authorization, consumption marker, local readiness receipt, and external wrapper uses this V3 object's sealed self_hash.value as the effective program contract identity.
effective_program_contract_identity.preserved_contract_bindings: Every local/external receipt additionally binds V2 and V1 semantic and raw-file SHA-256 values.

nested_structural_parser_file_law.write_law: After external response/journal verification, build the untouched Job-49 parser receipt, exclusively write the complete bytes at this exact attempt-local path, fsync file and directory, strictly reread canonical JSON, validate its self-hash/object against the declaration, and compare exact raw-file SHA-256 before the top-level wrapper is built.
nested_structural_parser_file_law.immutability_law: Never edit its Job49 rehearsal flags, never overwrite it, and never present it as the top-level Job-50 external receipt.
nested_structural_parser_file_law.top_level_binding: JOB50_EXTERNAL_METADATA_RECEIPT_V1 binds this exact repository-relative path, semantic receipt_sha256, and raw-file SHA-256.

external_pass_integrity_law.interpretation: A true credential/client flag and 2440 runner-observed SDK metadata method invocations are required external provenance, not an authority expansion. Low-level HTTP transactions and vendor/account overhead are not observed; HTTP transactions may differ because redirects are a transport behavior even with zero configured retries. The zero spend field proves only that this runner initiated no purchase or acquisition transaction. Every prohibited runner action remains zero or false.
external_pass_integrity_law.wrapper_law: The top-level external wrapper requires exact equality to this integrity object and authorization-effect text; local-readiness receipts continue to use their separate all-zero local integrity object.

construction_preconditions: strict V3 authorization reread, self-hash, raw-file, freshness, owner-attestation field, declaration, V1/V2/V3 contract, and attempt binding
credential read after every prior gate
dynamic pinned-client import/construction after credential read
authorized_external_client_capability.provenance_law: The capability is created only by construction_entrypoint, is not JSON/deserializable, and is revalidated by exact type plus every bound identity immediately before the first SDK call. A raw client, duck-typed client, caller-created dataclass lookalike, bare authorization hash, or public client/client_factory injection is refused.
authorized_external_client_capability.test_boundary: Fake authorized-external exercises use a separate private test-only capability/entrypoint that cannot emit an externally_supplied response, nested parser receipt, or top-level external PASS.

total_job50_stop_normalization.idempotence: Applying the normalizer to any mapped value twice returns the same Job-50 value.
total_job50_stop_normalization.unknown_status_law: An unknown status is never propagated as PASS; it normalizes to STOP_CONTRACT_OR_DECLARATION_DRIFT with the unknown token retained only in bounded diagnostic detail.
total_job50_stop_normalization.boundary: Every Job-50 public API, journal STOP, on-disk classifier, CLI diagnostic, and top-level receipt uses this normalizer. The untouched nested Job-49 receipt retains its original token.

manual_governance_inputs: the claim that the authorization was authored/approved by the owner
owner_attestation_epistemic_boundary.machine_verifiable: Code verifies exact canonical fields, formats, dates, internal hashes, contract/declaration/readiness links, attempt identity, freshness, one-use marker, and raw-file identity.
owner_attestation_epistemic_boundary.not_machine_verifiable: Local code cannot cryptographically prove who authored a chat message, that a digest corresponds to the current Codex conversation, or that a vendor credential was actually revoked/rotated. Those are trusted owner attestations under repository governance.
owner_attestation_epistemic_boundary.required_receipt_equality_law: Every top-level JOB50_EXTERNAL_METADATA_RECEIPT_V1 requires claims.owner_attestation_verification to equal OWNER_ATTESTED_NOT_CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY_VERIFIED exactly. Missing, renamed, differently valued, or nested-parser-only disclosure refuses PASS.
owner_attestation_epistemic_boundary.self_attestation_sufficiency_clarificati: Self-attestation is insufficient for call accounting, response integrity, or scope. Owner attestation is explicitly the governing input for authorship and credential-rotation facts that local code cannot independently establish.
owner_attestation_epistemic_boundary.fabrication_boundary: Fabrication or coordinated rewrite of the owner attestation and every retained local binding is outside the honest-runner/tamper-evidence claim and does not become cryptographic proof merely because hashes recompute.

v3_contract_identity_projection.authorization_strict_schema_law: The two intermediate fields are added to V2 required_exact_fields. All other V2 fields remain required and unknown fields remain forbidden. The authorization self-hash and raw-file hash bind all V3/V2/V1 identities.
v3_contract_identity_projection.consumption_record_mapping: The consumption marker carries the same exact V3/V2/V1 semantic/raw projection as the authorization and is included in its strict on-disk reread before credential access.
v3_contract_identity_projection.transitive_binding_not_sufficient: A local-readiness-receipt link alone is not a substitute for the direct V3/V2/V1 fields in the authorization, consumption marker, or external wrapper.
v3_contract_identity_projection.all_other_artifacts: Every V3 journal and response keeps its V2 schema and carries V3 as program_contract_sha256. Its local-readiness and authorization bindings lead to the direct preserved V2/V1 identities without inventing alternate base-field meanings.

databento_client_construction_identity.import_export_law: The readiness validator verifies the exact databento/__init__.py bytes and its AST export `from databento.historical.client import Historical`, then verifies the exact client.py bytes. The production factory dynamically resolves the exact databento.historical.client.Historical class after every precredential gate; it does not trust a caller-supplied or replaced top-level alias.
databento_client_construction_identity.constructor_static_law: The readiness validator verifies Historical.__init__(self,key=None,gateway=HistoricalGateway.BO1) has the inspected local structure: credential/gateway validation, assignments, and construction of BatchHttpAPI, MetadataHttpAPI, SymbologyHttpAPI, and TimeseriesHttpAPI only. It rejects request/socket/aiohttp calls or any other constructor call target. It also binds batch.py, timeseries.py, metadata.py, symbology.py, and common/http.py source bytes and verifies their inherited constructors perform assignments/base-URL construction only.
databento_client_construction_identity.precredential_reverification: The local-readiness receipt records these source identities, and production external-run natively re-verifies them before credential read and again before the exact capability constructor is used.
databento_client_construction_identity.bounded_claim: This closes the inspected default local import/constructor source path against same-version drift. It is not proof against a compromised Python import system, monkeypatching after verification, or coordinated rewrite of every retained local anchor.

urllib3_transport_identity.requests_adapter_static_law: The already-bound requests/adapters.py defines DEFAULT_RETRIES=0 and HTTPAdapter.__init__ assigns Retry(0, read=False) when max_retries equals that default.
urllib3_transport_identity.closure_law: The local readiness receipt binds and re-verifies urllib3 version, distribution METADATA, all named source bytes, and the requests adapter zero-retry AST pattern without importing the Databento client.
urllib3_transport_identity.bounded_claim: The inspected default Databento 0.77.0 -> requests 2.33.1 -> urllib3 2.6.3 source path configures zero automatic retries. This is a static local source-identity claim, not a guarantee against monkeypatching, vendor duplication, network intermediaries, or coordinated artifact rewrite.

preserved_contract_bindings: V2 semantic self-hash and raw-file SHA-256
V1 semantic self-hash and raw-file SHA-256
local_readiness_v3_delta.transport_bindings: Databento export/client constructor/endpoint/http, requests API/session/adapter, and urllib3 retry/connection/pool source identities
local_readiness_v3_delta.local_credential_zero_definition: Local receipt credentials_read=0 means no real or stored vendor secret, .env value, keychain value, or process credential was read. Tests may use an explicitly in-memory fake DATABENTO_API_KEY mapping and a private monkeypatched fake-construction seam; those are identified as synthetic test inputs, never counted as a vendor credential read, and cannot emit externally_supplied response, nested-parser, or external PASS evidence.

self_hash.procedure: Parse this file as strict JSON, copy the complete object, set copied self_hash.value to null and copied self_hash.status to NORMALIZED_FOR_HASH, serialize the copy with json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), hash the UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, then store the lowercase digest in self_hash.value and set stored self_hash.status to SEALED. Verification repeats the same normalization.
